title: 6515--SPS Reprocessing Sinks
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 23 (36C263)
description_text: The VA of Central Iowa Health Care System's Sterile Processing Services (SPS) requires reliable and ergonomically designed Steris Medivators 61 GI Reprocessing Sinks to ensure seamless operations and maintain high standards of patient care. These advanced sinks are intended to meet these needs, improve operational workflow, and reduce the risk of staff injury and burnout. The contractor shall provide all necessary labor, equipment, materials, and supervision to deliver and install the Steris Medivators 61 GI Reprocessing Sinks.
